title: GOAL: R22 — render errors become visible holds, spawn.render validates placeholders against the template, review respawns retry and cap
spec: Goal task (Planner-owned, no worker). Why: three gotchas on 2026-09-21 (T-0660, T-0667, T-0684/T-0686/T-0712) show that a spec or diff quoting a double-brace template placeholder makes spawn.render raise after substitution, the exception escapes daemon.dispatch in the tick thread (daemon.py:852-856) or kills spawn.run_worker silently (spawn.py:757-779), and the task looks merely queued or gets dispatched_at re-stamped every lease with no event. A review respawned once (daemon.py:922-962) is never retried, so a dead respawn leaves the review queued forever. Two execute tasks under this goal fix both. Run under [planner].autonomous = true (shadow routing) so headless Planner decision points produce telemetry; the interactive session must detach before launches fire (planner_runs._session_attached).
acceptance: Both execute tasks under this goal merge into goal/<this id> and .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh passes on that branch externally (main today: 1017 tests)

spawn.render only raises unfilled_placeholder for a token present in the prompt template and absent from its keyword arguments; substituted values may contain the double-brace syntax and are never substituted a second time
A render error during daemon dispatch, fresh-fix dispatch or spawn.run_worker leaves the task held with a hold_reason beginning render_error and a notify line, never silently requeued or re-stamped
A queued review or spec_review with a stale respawned_at is respawned again after respawn_after_s and held with hold_reason respawn_exhausted after [daemon].respawn_max attempts
Retrospective recorded in .orchestrator/memory/decisions.md and PR goal/<this id> -> main opened for the human
